overview: What are people so angry about in the countryside? Hege Moe Eriksen travels and discovers aspects of Norway she did not know about.
title: Brølet fra bygda

overview: Welcome to Bablo, the world's best library!
title: Bablo

overview: An Ex-Prime Minister must repay a million dollar advance for an autobiography he hasn't written - or get someone to write it for him ASAP.
title: The Ex-PM

overview: Morten shows you how you can make something cool with what you have at home!
title: Gjør det sjøl

overview: Axel goes on a camping trip with his dad so they can get to know each other better.
title: Sommeren med pappa

overview: A small otter cub moves under the terrace of the Veie-Rosvoll family. It is named Svenn and quickly becomes a good friend.
title: Oteren Svenn

overview: Yu Qing Luo gives birth to a son named Nan Nan. Seven years later, she becomes a renowned physician with unorthodox skills. She sets out to find Yang Xiu Cheng, Nan Nan's father. On her journey, she comes across a man named Ye Xiu Du, the prince of Feng Cang Kingdom. As Ye Xiu Du resembles Yang Xiu Cheng, Yu Qing Luo grew to resent him. However after several encounters, she realizes it was just a co-incidence and began to open up to him. At the same time, Yu Qing Luo's skills and talent attracted unwanted attention and she gets swept up in conflicts. Yu Qing Luo and Ye Xiu Du work together to defeat the opponents.
title: Qing Luo

overview: The whole story of the world's most famous monument is told for the first time, from its ancient beginnings to the groundbreaking renovation underway amid a storm of controversy.
title: Colosseum: The Whole Story

overview: Director William Karel examines the biggest stock market crash in history, which occurred on the New York Stock Exchange 80 years ago -- Black Thursday, October 24, 1929. In this film, a wide range of economists and historians take turns discussing the causes of the crash and its economic and political consequences. These included acute poverty and the rise of the extreme right, both of which were to have a considerable impact on the decade to come. 1929 uses a wealth of black-and-white archive footage to illustrate what the experts have to say.

A juicy four-part docuseries exploring the meteoric rise of tabloid media and the cut-throat players who blew up the news, Gossip digs deep into the ascent of Rupert Murdoch and America's insatiable appetite for dirt – featuring The New York Post's Cindy Adams and a who's-who of insider interviews. Money, power, sex, fame: everything's fair game when celebrity scoops and society scandals move from the margins to the mainstream and column inches turn into currency that could destroy reputations or even make a President.
title: Gossip

overview: Lee Marvin narrates which reenact various crimes that occurred around the United States. Although some were based on well-known events, others were more obscure.
title: The Lawbreakers

overview: Between Two Ferns with Zach Galifianakis is a talk show hosted by comedian Zach Galifianakis and featuring celebrity guests. Episodes last several minutes, in which the interviewer (Galifianakis) and guest trade barbs and insults. In addition to the online series, an additional episode was filmed for Comedy Central as a television special.
title: Between Two Ferns with Zach Galifianakis

overview: The all-new series Winter House, premiering this fall, will feature cast members from Summer House and Southern Charm, as well as their friends, during a two-week vacation at a ski house in Vermont,
title: Winter House

overview: Below Deck Adventure will feature wealthy thrill seekers as they get into all sorts of adrenaline-pumping activities on their luxury yacht vacation. Season 1 will take place in the glacial fjords of Norway.
title: Below Deck Adventure

overview: Below Deck Down Under follows yachties as they work and play on a super-yacht sailing around Australia. The series also showcases a unique additional challenge for the crew as the guests expect not only an adventure on the water but also underwater with scuba diving and other activities as some of the main attractions of the region.
title: Below Deck Down Under

overview: Irreverent is a fish out of water drama that follows criminal mediator Paulo Keegan as he flees Chicago and the United States after a mediation gone wrong and assumes the identity of Reverend Mackenzie "Mack" Boyd. Paulo posing as "Mack" finds himself trapped in Clump, Australia - a small, eccentric beach town in Far North Queensland hundreds of miles away from civilization and phone reception. In order to stay alive, "Mack" must keep the wool over the town's eyes and play the role of devoted Reverend, while desperately searching for an exit strategy before his past catches up to him.
title: Irreverent

overview: Nuclear Family follows filmmaker Ry Russo-Young as she turns the camera on her own past to explore the meaning of family. In the late 70s/early 80s, when the concept of a gay family was inconceivable to most, Ry and her sister Cade were born to two lesbian mothers through sperm donors. Ry's idyllic childhood was threatened by an unexpected lawsuit which sent shockwaves through her family's lives and continues to reverberate today. An exploration of love, loyalty, loss and the immutable power of family in all its configurations, Nuclear Family eloquently examines the dynamics that enrich and complicate the bonds of love.
title: Nuclear Family

overview: Bettany Hughes take viewers on armchair travels to explore household-name treasures and new finds from across the world.
title: Bettany Hughes Treasures of the World

overview: Adam Hills, Alex Brooker, Josh Widdicombe and Rosie Jones present live daily from the Olympic Park in Stratford, London, rounding up the biggest sporting events of the day and connecting with Paralympians in Tokyo.
title: The Last Leg of Tokyo 2020

overview: Celebrities give back to the people who have made a difference in their lives by helping to create their one-of-a-kind, automotive masterpiece.
title: Celebrity IOU: Joyride

overview: A romantic comedy about female friendship, following childhood best friends Maggie and Birdy. Based on the memoir by Dolly Alderton.
title: Everything I Know About Love

overview: Coercion depicts Bender's (Chandler) escape from the world of sex trafficking after six years, her struggles to return to a "normal" life, and her emergence as a confident, funny and impassioned advocate for justice.
title: Coercion

overview: The story of a young cop from the police academy, Lin Qiang. Her parents were killed by a drug lord. The police force arranged for Lin Qiang to go undercover and start a covert mission to collect evidence from the drug dealer. She then meets the mysterious adopted son, Zhang Xian He of the current drug lord. She pretends to fall in love with him to obtain some vital information about the organization and at the same time feels torn. He, in turn, is also in turmoil when he figures out her identity.
title: Stealth Walker

overview: In the late 1970s, an accused serial rapist claims multiple personalities control his behavior, setting off a legal odyssey that captivates America.
title: Monsters Inside: The 24 Faces of Billy Milligan

overview: Shudder, AMC Networks' premium streamer for horror, thriller and the supernatural, announced the new original docu-series Behind the Monsters, which takes a deep dive on cinematic horror icons. Each of the series' six episodes will focus on a single horror character, including Freddy Krueger, Jason Voorhees, Michael Myers, Candyman, Chucky and Pinhead, and feature interviews with horror experts and the writers, directors and actors from the original films that made each character the stuff of genre legends.
title: Behind the Monsters

overview: Hunters Walk was devised by Dixon of Dock Green creator Ted Willis and features excellent scripts by Roger Marshall (Public Eye) and Peter J. Hammond (Sapphire and Steel). Based at a police station in a fictional Midlands town, Its small, idiosyncratic team of officers face a typically broad spectrum of cases, from neighbours' disputes and hooliganism to suspected murder.
title: Hunter's Walk

overview: Legends of the Fall is produced with truly die hard deer hunters in mind. Legends of the Fall chronicles the high-energy hunts and behind-the-scenes action of a dedicated crew of passionate hunters. While the show spotlights a dynamic variety of adrenaline-pumping whitetail bow hunts across North America, it also offers a mix of other big game adventures. Shot in a format similar to the hit series "24", each episode details the lives of all "clan" members in their tireless, year-round pursuit of all-things whitetail. From shed hunting and food plot planting to pre-season scouting and the harvesting of giant trophies, Legends of the Fall promises to feed viewers whitetail addiction.
title: Legends of the Fall

overview: Roads to our time is a Norwegian documentary series about recent Norwegian history which was broadcast on NRK in 1991. The documentary deals with Norway's history from 1950 to 1990.
title: Veier til vår tid

overview: Dentist Ai Jing Chu, who also teaches at Donghu University, is known to be the most handsome man at school. University librarian Zeng Li, however, is prejudiced against him because of a little misunderstanding. When Zeng Li's mother forces her to get braces, she tries to avoid Ai Jing Chu at all costs, but eventually still ends up becoming his patient. As the two interact more and more with each other, Zeng Li realizes that Ai Jing Chu is actually a very professional and caring person, and starts to develop feelings for him. Adapted from the novel "A Speck Amid the Dust of the World"
title: Sweet Teeth

overview: Climate psychologist Per Espen Stoknes at BI shows what mechanisms are in us that make us climate sinkers, even though we know better.
title: Hvorfor gjør vi så lite når vi vet så mye?

overview: In 2048 a TV-station has found a couple of old documentaries from 1988, and show them again as proof that they already back then knew what could happen with climatic changes.
title: Året 2048

overview: Four teenagers are going on their generation's most important expedition - to understand the climate.
title: Oppdrag Nansen

overview: Krafttaket was a Norwegian game show that aired on NRK1 in 2008 and 2010. Environmental protection and climate emissions were the theme of the competition. The series was set up as a competition between two cities over who could reduce climate emissions the most.
title: Krafttaket

overview: Hunt Masters combines the adrenaline-fueled excitement of the best outdoor adventure television, stunning visuals of the world's most exotic and remote wildlife locales, and the hard-earned wisdom, insight and laconic humor of one of hunting's most respected sportsmen, Gregg Ritz. Throughout the series he tests his endurance, hones his skill and emboldens his spirit by teaming up with new characters each week who have dedicated their lives to becoming Hunt Masters.
title: Hunt Masters

overview: Idolized medium João Teixeira de Faria rises to international fame before horrifying abuse is revealed by survivors, prosecutors and the press.
title: João de Deus - Cura e Crime

overview: Amid project pitfalls and a pandemic, besties-turned-business partners bring their design magic to a rundown motel and revamp it into a go-to getaway.
title: Motel Makeover

overview: Kürt Rogiers and Tooske Ragas, together with viewing Flanders and the Netherlands, are looking for the newest K3 member. Who will soon shine on stage next to Hanne and Marthe?
title: K2 zoekt K3

overview: Luk Alloo portrays strong people with a haunting and special story that has determined their lives.
title: Alloo

overview: In Sevier County, Arkansas, an unprecedented drug rehabilitation program gives qualified inmates a second chance at life. If they complete the three-month program, they will be released from jail. If they mess up, they will do time in state prison.
title: The Program Prison Detox

overview: Within Alaska's wild and harsh landscape lurk some of the most dangerous criminals in America. The 10-episode true crime series Cold Blooded Alaska uncovers Alaska's most disturbing crimes and unpacks the extraordinary lengths law enforcement working in the Last Frontier must take to bring killers to justice.
title: Cold Blooded Alaska

overview: The British writer Rosamunde Pilcher is the namesake of the successful ZDF film series. Based on their novels, more than 100 television films are made, whose emotional stories full of love and passion, tragic accidents and dramatic strokes of fate are always embedded in the picturesque landscapes of English or Scottish coastal regions. This mostly strongly romanticized world of great feelings and dreamlike backdrops has given ZDF the best ratings since 1993.
title: The Rosamunde Pilcher Collection

overview: From Covid to lockdowns to exam chaos, lately schoolkids have had the toughest of times. Pupils at a Midlands school film their year of turning 16 and taking GCSEs in the middle of a pandemic.
title: Sixteen: Class of 2021

overview: Alexis Conran finds out how takeaway shops keep us coming back for more - and what we can do to get more for our money.
title: Secrets of the Fast Food Giants

overview: Who is to blame for more and more boys falling on the outside? Is it the politicians, the school, the "system", or the girls? Or they themselves?
title: Gutter mot verden

overview: A family man disappears, but something is wrong. Police are desperately looking for evidence of what happened. True crime about Per Vålnes who disappeared in 2011.
title: Vålnes-saken

overview: Hodet i klemme is the sports documentary about being beaten in life both on and off the mat, and still getting up again and again.
title: Hodet i klemme

overview: Helene Sandvig gets to know people who live differently and who believe things that others may be angry at or condemn. Helene wants to understand more about why they think and live as they do.
title: Helene sjekker ut

overview: In the series Rus, Leo Ajkic tries to understand more of what makes intoxication so digg for some, but dangerous for others. Among other things, he is a fly on the wall during drug treatment, meets survivors who have lost someone after an overdose, but he is also present when the Russian buses roll in intoxication of joy. The documentary series is based on an extensive insight work where the editors have talked to young people from upper secondary schools all over the country about their experiences with drugs and what they really wonder about drugs. In the conversations, it became clear that they think parents know too little and that adults such as police and teachers can quickly become moralizing and judgmental, while friends and enthusiasts tend to discredit the use of alcohol and other drugs.
title: Rus

overview: Cunning, desperate, well-informed and manipulative stakeholders go on display. Who will win the bidding war?
title: Visning

overview: Ikke gjør dette mot klimaet is a spectacular entertainment series with an important message. The series is fronted by two children aged 13 and Newton's famous host, Dennis Siva Lie. The goal is to explain the connection between small things you do in everyday life and the global climate. The TV series provides good advice and tips on how to avoid such disasters, and how you can talk to the children about everyone being able to help slow down development.
title: Ikke gjør dette mot klimaet

overview: In Verst når det gjelder we meet the Bock family - a divorce of five who are in the process of establishing a new everyday life after father Håkon has been unfaithful and thrown out. Håkon ends up moving down to the basement apartment which he has to share with the eldest son Aksel.
title: Verst når det gjelder

overview: Deep in the forest, a secret universe has come to life. This is where Jakten takes place - an intense game where children get the opportunity to compete against their celebrity heroes and idols. A team consisting of three friends between the ages of 10 and 13 is released on an illuminated course, where they must work together to solve exciting and logical tasks. The goal is to get out, before they are taken. For they are not alone in the forest. The team is being chased by a masked hunter who wants to prevent them from escaping. But who is hiding behind the mask?
title: Jakten

overview: You are never too small to do something big and everyone can do a little. An environmental program for the youngest.
title: Planetpatruljen

overview: In Latterlig politikk, nine comedians compete to learn as much as possible about the politics of a party they have been assigned, and which they must eventually defend in a live debate.
title: Latterlig politikk

overview: When will you be convicted under the racism clause? Is it too easy to get away with racism today, or is the law too strict? Do farmers who practice meat get too much hatred or is the criticism legitimate? In Er dette politikk? (Is this politics?) Bahare Viken addresses engaging topics that many do not think of as politics, but which in fact are.
title: Er dette politikk?

overview: Annerledes is a program series over eight episodes where we through host Emma Ellingsen in each program get to know a new person who tells his personal story. Emma meets people who have had to fight to be accepted for their differences.
title: Annerledes

overview: Influencers Emma Ellingsen meets other committed, young people who are passionate about everything from cars and the environment to make-up, health care and leisure clubs. The hope is that the meetings will help Emma find out what she will vote for in the parliamentary elections.
title: Emmas stemme

overview: In this documentary series, Solveig Kloppen and Geir Fredriksen meet close family members who have broken contact, and who are now trying to find each other again.
title: En del av meg

overview: The tasks are many and varied: Who can build a bridge that can withstand half a ton of weights? Who builds the tallest tower, the nicest apartment or the fastest car? The answer will probably surpass anything you previously thought was possible when it comes to LEGO. There will be passion, high-level sports, strong emotions and magic - and an eternal battle to surpass oneself and the competitors. Only one team remains the winner of 500,000 kroner.
title: LEGO Masters Norge

overview: Is it possible to take a 5-year-old on a 400-kilometer expedition in the winter? Alexander Read and his daughter Mina (5) have decided to cross the Finnmarksvidda from Vardø to Alta. They expect to spend 24 days on the expedition they have planned together.
title: Mina og meg

overview: Petter Nyquist and Svein Stang from Petter uteligger have lived very different lives, on different sides. But, in turn in an old public transport bus, they find that they have a surprising amount in common, all the way back from childhood!
title: Petter og Svein stikker

overview: In The Glades, Jim Longworth, is a brilliant homicide detective from Chicago who moves to South Florida after being shot by his captain. He assumes it will afford him a more relaxing lifestyle, but he finds things are more complicated than he had imagined when he finds himself solving unlikely crimes in the town of Palm Glade, Florida.
title: The Glades

overview: The CNN Documentary Unit tackles the most compelling, current, and complex stories of our time. Startling events. Pressing issues. Extraordinary journeys. Intriguing topics. These are the stories that matter most; stories told with depth and drama, from the most honored documentary series in cable news.
title: CNN Special Report

overview: Hosts Hjalmar and India test products, visit factories and demand answers from responsible adults. In addition, they offer a solid dose of play, humor and a cracking good helper named Junior.
title: TV 2 hjelper deg junior

overview: For Torodd and the four other rånerene from rural Norway, most of life is about cars and life on the road, but we also get an insight into everyday ups and downs, romantic moments and conflicts.
title: Wunderland

overview: Newly arrived in Oslo, Ida cannot shake a constant feeling that disaster - especially terrorism - is just around the corner. So when she meets Axel, a young man with connections to the incel (involuntary celibate) subculture, Ida becomes convinced that he is a future school shooter - and that she has a personal responsibility to stop a catastrophe.
title: Ida tar ansvar

overview: An investigation into a botched kidnapping uncovers long-held secrets connecting multiple characters and cultures in present day New York City.
title: Full Circle

overview: Dale Brisby uses social media savvy and rodeo skills to keep cowboy traditions alive — and now he's teaching the world how to cowboy right.
title: How to Be a Cowboy

overview: Sparks fly and tensions flare in Metal Shop Masters, a fierce, fiery competition between 7 of America's top welding legends. Hosted by Jo Koy, over the course of six episodes, these iron men and women race against the clock in challenging builds ranging from epic, one-of-a-kind grills to futuristic vehicles, all judged on both form and function. Pressure, heat and hustle makes for grinding work, and in the end, only one will forge a path to victory and the title of Metal Shop Master.
title: Metal Shop Masters

overview: Baking It is a holiday competition series in which eight teams of two talented home bakers join Maya Rudolph and Andy Samberg's winter cabin for a celebration of culinary holiday traditions. Contestant duos will include spouses, siblings, best friends and more, who will work together to create outstanding savory and sweet creations for themed challenges with the hopes of winning a cash prize. Maya and Andy will lead the festivities, also providing comedic and musical commentary on the action. The bakers' holiday treats will be judged by tough critics – four opinionated real-life grandmothers, who happen to be fantastic bakers themselves!
title: Baking It

overview: We will show you how your car can be stolen! Look and don't let it happen!
title: Угон

overview: For three years, Vlad Chizhov has been successfully helping people who have suffered at the hands of scammers. But Vlad is one, and there are too many scammers. Now a team of hunters will work with him: they will infiltrate the schemes of swindlers, bring them out into the open and hand them over to the police.
title: Охотники

overview: Elena Letuchaya starts the war against injustice again. This time, the target is low-quality services, manufacturers of products and goods that we use on a daily basis. Elena will talk about the rights and obligations of producers of food and other goods, about what the buyer can demand from the producers and the trading network that sells these goods, and will show by her own example how to restore justice.
title: Летучий надзор

overview: After a lifetime of unbridled hedonism drinking and sleeping her way up and down Broadway Tony winning diva Madison Banks (Kirstie Alley) is confronted by something far more shocking than her usual opening night key parties: Arlo Barth, the son (Eric Petersen) she gave up for adoption 26 years ago. Maddie has played countless roles on stage, but one part shes not fit to play is anyones mother. Racked with guilt and completely out of her element, Maddie almost denies her son a second time how can an acclaimed actress and noted head case like Maddie possibly relate to a Jersey donut maker? But with the help of her long-suffering assistant and best friend Thelma Katz (Rhea Pearlman) and her eccentric chauffeur Frank Baxter (Michael Richards), Maddie realizes that Arlo is a diamond in the rough and invites him to move into her Park Avenue condo. As Thelma and Frank show Arlo the ropes of Maddies uninhibited, unapologetic and occasionally unhinged life and tries to build a new one of his own in Manhattan this new makeshift family learns that its newest member isnt the only gem that could use a little polish.
title: Kirstie

overview: Chef and restaurateur Nisha Katona goes on a culinary journey to discover Italy's hidden foodie gems, learning the regional secrets that influence their dishes.
title: A Taste of Italy

overview: Emmy Award Winning Documentary Series that chronicles the 12 Greatest Boxing match ups on HBO, including rare footage and interviews.
title: Legendary Nights

overview: Hardcore Pawn: Chicago takes viewers behind the scenes at Royal Pawn Shop in Chicago.
title: Hardcore Pawn: Chicago

overview: Hands is a unique, multi-award winning series of thirty-seven documentaries on Irish crafts. Made by the renowned filmmaking team, David and Sally Shaw-Smith, it was originally produced for Irish television (RTÉ). Imbued by a sense of urgency, the Shaw-Smiths travelled the length and breadth of Ireland during the 1970s and '80s, capturing on film the final years of traditional rural and urban life. These intimate portraits are as much about the life of the individuals as the crafts they practised. The films capture the essence of Irish heritage, creating a unique archive of life in Ireland at the end of the 20th century.
title: Hands

overview: The family lives of those working on Australia's Snowy Mountains dam in the 1950s.
title: Snowy

overview: Stalked: Followed by Fear is a half-hour docuseries that examines the twisted psychology of stalkers, as victims share their stories. In the series opener, "Neighborhood Nightmare," a college student is swept off her feet by a deceptively charming man, but he soon reveals his true nature; a friendship with a new neighbor turns sour when it becomes obsessive. Then, in "Teenage Terror," an art class acquaintance becomes a dangerous stalker; a fifth grader's decision to befriend a strange girl has life-altering consequences.
title: Stalked: Followed by Fear

overview: Set amongst the beach clubs and palm trees of the Costa del Sol in the early 80s, A Town Called Malice follows the Lords, a crime family of petty thieves from South London, as they decamp from London to Spain to profit from an unexpected windfall – and to escape the attention of the police in a high-profile murder enquiry.
title: A Town Called Malice

overview: Alhaja Eniola Salami starts anew and sets her sights on a different position of power, fueled by revenge, regret and ruthlessness.
title: King of Boys: The Return of the King

overview: A new type of survival show is here. Hottest stars in the industry try to find the next future stars. Stars become the fan of the future stars and try to support them. While competing one another, these future stars have to gather as much fans from the public. Which star will pick the brightest start of all? Who will the nation pick? Various stars will pay a visit to the show each week to introduce the rookies to the viewers. Stay tuned for beautiful performances and amazing talent that shines. Which celebrity will be gather the most fans for their rookie? Which rookie will be chosen by the public? The toughest competition begins now.
title: The Fan

overview: Featuring rare footage and intimate details about the mavericks who shaped American culture. Travel deep inside the lives of these icons with friends and family who reveal the meteoric highs and the devastating costs of fame.
title: Superstar

overview: Hungry for It gives 10 aspiring cooks from all over the UK, all desperate to carve out a career in the food industry, a chance to skill up and put their talent to the test, with one amateur cook winning a life changing prize. The chefs will live together in a house, whilst competing and creating amazing dishes, in an attempt to impress industry experts and mentors. This exciting new competition plays out in two distinct spaces – a restaurant and a street-food inspired pop-up.
title: Hungry for It

overview: Black Ops is the story of Dom and Kay, who join the Met Police in the hope of cleaning up their community but are unwittingly thrust into the murky world of deep cover infiltration as they become part of a powerful criminal enterprise. But for Dom and Kay it quickly becomes more of a fiasco than Donnie Brasco…
title: Black Ops
